description.value: Rice & Noodle is a casual fast-casual Thai and Asian kitchen on Vancouver's busy Robson Street, best known for its pad thai and fully customizable dishes — diners pick a base, protein, and spice level from none to extreme. The kitchen cooks fresh in front of customers, with a menu spanning curries, noodle dishes, stir-fries, and soups. Online ordering is available alongside dine-in, making it a convenient fuel stop on a city cycling route.
